:::{#cor-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-fraction}
#### Hessian contribution of one binary outcome over a common denominator

If $\Outvar_\iobs \sim \Ber(\prob)$ has observed value $\outvar_\iobs \in \cb{0, 1}$,
its [Hessian](#def-hessian) contribution, written with the [precision](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-precision) $\precision = 1 / \paren{\prob(1 - \prob)}$, is:

$$\hess_\iobs(\prob) = -\sqf{\precision} \paren{\paren{1 - 2 \prob} \outvar_\iobs + \sqf{\prob}}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-fraction, worked in @sol-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-fraction.
It follows from @thm-bernoulli-hessian-contribution.

:::
